question: Dobutamine differs from dopamine in that

options.opa: It has good blood-brain barrier penetrability
options.opc: It does not activate adrenergic b receptors
options.opd: It does not activate peripheral dopaminergic receptors

analysis: Dobutamine primarily acts on beta-1 adrenergic receptors, leading to increased cardiac output with less pronounced effects on heart rate compared to other catecholamines. Unlike dopamine, dobutamine does not significantly activate peripheral dopaminergic receptors, which are involved in vasodilation and increased renal perfusion.
